title: Mitchell Fraboni will be the Bronco long snapper in 2026

sources.title: Mitchell Fraboni will be the Bronco long snapper in 2026
sources.description: For the last four seasons, Mitch Fraboni has been the Bronco long snapper (he was the LS for part of 2022). Long snappers are critical, but forgotten parts of every football team. Like offensive linemen, they only get noticed if they screw up. Mitch is not only a competent long snapper, but he is also […]
